entities.name: Eye
entities.description: A creature type for magical sentient beings that appear as large floating single eyes; this page covers the game type and its species across planes.

entities.name: Evil Eye of Urborg
entities.description: An Evil Eye in Urborg's swamp appearing as an eyeball on a floating mass of flesh.

entities.name: Eyetwitch
entities.description: Eye Bat of Arcavios prized by ocolumancers.

entities.name: Creeping Peeper
entities.description: Spider-like Duskmourn creature with a central golden eye that acts as Valgavoth's eyes.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Entity for whom Creeping Peepers act as eyes.

entities.name: Atraxi
entities.description: Doctor Who species of sapient alien eyes.

relations.quote: They act as eyes for Valgavoth .
